title: Pull a graphics card out of its PCIe x16 slot while holding the spring retention latch open
instruction: Put the green graphics card into the grey tray, pressing the orange latch tab to free it.
context: Removing a graphics card from a desktop workstation is a routine step in PC and workstation service (repairs, GPU swaps and upgrades by computer service technicians and IT support). The Dell Precision 3660 Tower Service Manual, section 'Removing the graphics card', says to push and hold the securing tab on the graphics-card slot and lift the graphics card from the slot: one hand holds the spring-return x16 retention latch open while the other peels the card out of 164 gold contacts without hitting the CPU heatsink or memory, or dropping it. Real counterpart: a Dell Precision 3660 Tower with its own system board, CPU heatsink and DDR5 DIMMs (side cover and PCIe door open, laid on its side on the bench) and an NVIDIA T400 4GB low-profile card (68.9 x 155.9 mm, 123.5 g, PCIe 3.0 x16; listed as a 3660 discrete graphics option) in the primary x16 slot. The card overhangs the slot by about 52 mm, so the latch tab is reached beside the card's back face.
setup: Station table coordinates in metres: x forward from the arm-base line, y left, h up from the table top (world z = TOP + h). Arm bases at (0.000, +0.305) and (0.000, -0.305). The card and slot are turned 90 deg about vertical: the card plane is x = 0.180 (PCB 0.1792 to 0.1808), its long axis runs along +y (tail end at y = -0.030, bracket end toward +y) and the shroud face points to -x, toward the arms and the top camera. Grey rubber bench mat 0.440 x 0.640 x 0.003 m, x 0.060 to 0.500, y -0.300 to 0.340, centre (0.2800, 0.0200, h=0.0015). Fixed grey plate standing in for the tower's sheet-steel chassis wall under the board (modelled as a 2 mm aluminium plate; the chassis walls, rear wall, power supply and drive bays are not modelled) 0.250 x 0.295 x 0.002 m, x 0.115 to 0.365, y -0.150 to 0.145, h 0.003 to 0.005, centre (0.2400, -0.0025, h=0.0040). The tower's system board (dark green FR4, modelled as a 0.244 x 0.244 x 0.0016 m slab; the heatsink and DIMM positions relative to the slot are approximate, not measured from a 3660 board), x 0.116 to 0.360, y -0.120 to 0.124, h 0.0110 to 0.0126, centre (0.2380, 0.0020, h=0.0118), on four brass standoffs 5 mm dia x 6 mm at x = 0.126 and 0.350, y = -0.110 and 0.114. Fixed black plastic x16 slot housing: footprint x 0.176 to 0.184, y 0.0105 to 0.1165 (latch pocket y 0.0105 to 0.0225, channel y 0.0225 to 0.1165), top at h=0.0236 (11 mm above the board), channel floor, front end wall y 0.1120 to 0.1165, three fixed side-wall blocks at y 0.025 to 0.0325, 0.0625 to 0.0725 and 0.1025 to 0.112, four sprung side pads (black, effective friction 0.6 against the card) at y 0.0345 to 0.0605 and 0.0745 to 0.1005 on both sides of the card (10,250 N/m, 1 mm preload). Spring retention latch (black ABS lever, hinge axis along x at (0.1800, 0.0240, h=0.0131), spring 0.53 N m/rad, rests on a locked stop, opens 12 deg when its press tab is pushed down, hook lip 1 mm over the card's notch jaw edge at y = 0.0225 on a 30,000 N/m flex joint); its press tab 19 mm (x 0.183 to 0.202) by 10 mm (y -0.0095 to 0.0005), h 0.0206 to 0.0261, with an orange patch over the whole tab top; the tab sits under the card's overhang beside the PCB back face (+x side, 3 to 22 mm off the PCB plane), between the card and the CPU heatsink, and is pressed down from above beside the card. Graphics card (NVIDIA T400 4GB low profile, mass 0.125 kg, card origin (0.1800, -0.0300, h=0.0146)): black PCB 155.9 x 68.9 x 1.57 mm, y -0.030 to 0.1259, h 0.0229 to 0.0835 (top edge), seated in the slot with the tail end at y = -0.030, so it overhangs the slot channel by about 52 mm; gold fingers (89 mm, 52.5 to 141.5 mm from the tail, y 0.0225 to 0.1115, h 0.0146 to 0.0229, about 14.5 mm from the bracket) hidden in the slot, with the retention notch jaw (y 0.0225 to 0.0275, h 0.0146 to 0.0186) at the tail-side end of the fingers; black plastic shroud over an aluminium heatsink, 138 x 15 mm on the -x face (x 0.165 to 0.1792, y -0.018 to 0.120, h 0.0266 to 0.0831); steel full-height bracket 120 mm tall x 18.4 mm x 1 mm at x 0.1641 to 0.1825, y 0.1259 to 0.1269, h 0.0086 to 0.1286, free (bracket screw removed, PCIe door open); a 40 mm wide green vinyl tape band, 95 to 135 mm from the tail end (y 0.065 to 0.105), across the top edge, down the shroud face to the shroud bottom (h 0.0266) and down the PCB back face (+x side) to h 0.0446. The system's CPU heatsink (modelled as a 95 x 95 x 54 mm block: grey aluminium fin stack under a black plastic fan top) 0.095 x 0.095 m, x 0.220 to 0.315, y 0.000 to 0.095, centre (0.2675, 0.0475), h 0.0126 to 0.0666. Two DDR5 DIMMs with grey aluminium heat spreaders, 7 mm x 133 mm x 38 mm tall, at x 0.220 to 0.353, y -0.1085 to -0.1015 and -0.0975 to -0.0905, h 0.0126 to 0.0506, in black sockets 10 x 145 mm (x 0.214 to 0.359, h to 0.0206).
scoring: SCORE_OVER=end; SUCCESS_HOLD_S=0.05 s. Score and success share one evaluation per step. Ladder (evaluated every step, the final-step value counts): 0.25 tail end bottom corner at least 5 mm above its seated height (h 0.0229); 0.5 gold finger bottoms at least 10 mm above the slot top (h >= 0.0336) or wholly outside the slot footprint (x 0.176 to 0.184, y 0.0105 to 0.1165) seen from above, +-2 mm; 1.0 card entirely inside the tray interior (x 0.152 to 0.448, y 0.147 to 0.323, h up to 0.060), PCB within 10 deg of flat, card at rest (< 10 mm/s, < 0.5 rad/s), both grippers open (pad gap >= 30 mm) and every gripper probe point (TCP, tips, pad surfaces) at least 50 mm from the card, the slot housing with latch tab (x 0.176 to 0.202, y -0.0095 to 0.1165) and the tray walls and floor (these parts are sampled as real surfaces, 6 mm spacing), all held for 20 consecutive steps (1.0 s at 20 Hz). Otherwise 0.0, so the 0.25 and 0.5 states count only while they hold at the end. Latched violations (score 0.0 for the rest of the episode): (1) latch_forced: the card is seated while its tail corner and notch jaw (bottom of the jaw under the hook, 52.5 to 57.5 mm from the tail) are under 2 mm above their seated height and the fingers are in the slot; while seated a flag is reset to 'tab pressed now'; afterwards it becomes true on any step where the tab is pressed: the latch is at least 5 deg open (of 12 deg travel) AND a finger pad touches the orange tab top (some point of either pad, both pads sampled as solid boxes on a 2 mm grid, within 2 mm of the tab-top surface, anywhere on the 10 x 19 mm patch, at the current latch angle); a gripper hovering more than 2 mm above it does not count; pressed means contact plus latch angle, not a measured force; if the tail corner or notch jaw is 3 mm or more above its seated height, or the gold fingers are out of the slot, while the flag is false, latch_forced. Check on video: the card's tail end or connector comes up while no finger is on the orange tab with the tab pushed down. (2) card_dropped: while no gripper holds the card (closed, pad within 8 mm of the card), its lowest point falls more than 30 mm below where it was when released; check on video with tape on the background: the card falls 30 mm or more after leaving the hand. (3) card_off_bench: any card point beyond the mat (x 0.060 to 0.500, y -0.300 to 0.340) or 20 mm below the table top. (4) card_hit_cooler, card_hit_dimm0, card_hit_dimm1: card surface within 1 mm of the CPU heatsink or a DIMM with its socket; visible contact on video. (5) card_hit_board: gold fingers touching the board top (h <= 0.0136) outside the slot footprint +-3 mm. Photo/tape: gauge stands on the motherboard top (15.3 mm step = 5 mm tail lift, 21.0 mm step = 10 mm above slot top): tail lift against the 5 mm step in the side view, finger bottom above the 10 mm step, 10 deg wedge beside the flat card, card inside the tray outline in the overhead view, open hands clear for 1.0 s.
reset_notes: Reseat the card until the latch closes with a click, tail end at (0.1800, -0.0300), card overhanging the slot end by about 52 mm, with the card plane at x = 0.180; check the green tape band (40 mm, 95 to 135 mm from the tail end, over the top edge and down both faces) and the orange patch on the tab (beside the card's back face); check the latch spring returns the tab hands-free and the card does not lift under its own weight; empty the tray and square the tower and tray to the template.
fidelity: Rigid PhysX 20 Hz, 3 cameras 320x176; card is the only free body. Board layout approximate, not measured from a 3660; chassis walls not modelled. 4 sprung pads lump the 164 contacts (0.6 via PhysX average friction combine): ~24.6 N straight, ~12.3 N tail half; tab ~2-7 N; all model estimates (spec floor 12.3 N). Pressed = latch 5 deg open + finger pad within 2 mm of the tab top: contact, not force. Drive targets re-applied each step; no teleports or glue.
